titulo: Link the category from the staff positions list
ayuda_boton: Help on the category from the staff positions list
ayuda: Before the person is added to Personnel, the case must be linked to a published category of the staff positions list. The category is the one set in the HR analysis. Check that it is correct and select Link this category. If it is not, correct the analysis. If the analysis changes later, come back here to link the new category.
cargando: Checking the category of the case…
categoria_analisis: Category set by the HR analysis
origen: This category comes from the HR analysis and cannot be changed here. If it is wrong, correct the analysis and come back to this section.
aviso_vincular: Once linked, the case is tied to this category. To change it later you will have to record a new link.
vinculada_texto: You can now prepare the onboarding in Personnel, below.
cambio_analisis: The linked category ({anterior}) no longer matches the analysis. Link the current category.
no_publicada: The category from the analysis is not among the published categories. Ask the person who manages the category catalogue to publish it, then select Refresh.
sin_publicadas: No categories have been published yet. Ask the person who manages the category catalogue to publish it, then select Refresh.
pendiente: The category cannot be linked yet because the HR analysis of this case is not confirmed. Confirm it in the analysis step of this case, then select Refresh.
denegada: You do not have permission to link the category of this case.
conflicto: The case or its analysis has changed. Select Refresh and check the category again.
rechazada: The link was not accepted. Select Refresh and try again. If it keeps happening, contact IT.
no_disponible: The category cannot be checked right now. Select Refresh. If it keeps happening, contact IT.
incierto: We could not confirm whether the link was recorded. Select Check the link before trying again.
